title: mart_risk_register's risk_id assignment was nondeterministic
root_cause: ORDER BY had no tiebreaker for a real tie in probability_pct between two risk-register rows
detection_method: Detected via 3 repeated rebuilds showing 2 different row orderings with no code change between them; fix confirmed stable across 5 further rebuilds
regression_safeguard: Explicit risk_name asc tiebreaker added to the ORDER BY, documented in-code

title: A full source audit found AI-generated content citing events after the model's training cutoff, never independently verified
root_cause: Facts authored about real-world events postdating the training cutoff were never checked against their actual cited sources
detection_method: 15 originally-cited sources fetched live and checked verbatim against their claims; unsupported items triggered targeted follow-up research to find real sources or confirm none exist
regression_safeguard: Corrected sources, dates, and figures across 8 seed files; swapped a formula's role assumptions where the real data inverted a fabricated one; removed 2 claims with zero real support rather than replacing them with different invented numbers
